# Scott Hynd

Scott Hynd provides practical AI, website and workflow help for small businesses.

Website: https://scotthynd.com/
Website check: https://scotthynd.com/website-check/
Email: scott@scotthynd.com
Location: Brisbane, Queensland, Australia

## What Scott Helps With

- AI possibility checks for small businesses
- missed enquiry and quote follow-up workflows
- repeated customer question and FAQ reply builders
- admin cleanup and weekly owner catch-up workflows
- website clarity improvements
- practical visibility fixes for Google, AI tools, and customers

## Primary Offers

- AI Possibility Check
- Small Business Website Check
- Missed Enquiry Recovery
- Quote Follow-Up Mini-System
- Website Opportunity Pack
- Search and Visibility Fixes

## Common Problems

- missed enquiries
- slow quote follow-up
- repeated customer questions
- admin overload
- unclear website messaging
- weak local search visibility
- business websites that do not make the next step clear

## Positioning

Plain-English help turning repeated business tasks, enquiry follow-up, quote chasing, admin friction, website confusion, and weak search visibility into simple tools, workflows, clearer copy, and next steps.

## Best Fit

- local service businesses
- small business owners
- consultants and small teams
- businesses relying on enquiries, quotes, referrals, reputation, and consistent follow-up
- Brisbane businesses wanting local practical help
- remote small businesses that need plain-English AI or workflow support

## Not A Fit

- hype-led AI transformation programs
- enterprise AI strategy projects
- vague automation without a real business problem

## Primary Offer

Send through a business, website, or one repeated admin task, and Scott can suggest practical places where AI, a simple workflow, or a small tool could help.

## Website Opportunity Pack

A practical review showing what a business website could say more clearly, where the trust gaps are, and what a stronger next-step path could look like before a full rebuild.

## Small Business Website Check

A short plain-English review of one website page for service wording, enquiry path, FAQs, next steps, and whether Google or AI-search tools can clearly understand the business.

## Search and Visibility Fixes

Plain-English improvements so Google, AI tools, and customers can better understand what the business does, where it operates, and what to do next.
